scope: Integration verification only: five autonomous forecasts on the first official validation trajectory. No reserved test outcomes. Not convergence, accuracy ranking, speedup or CPU/Metal optimization-equivalence evidence.
checkpoint_recipe: Original 128x10, CPU 100-update faithful smoke checkpoint, seed 20261004, pilot training fixtures. Same checkpoint loaded on both devices.

verification.native_metal: all five policies completed with PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=0
verification.CPU_resume: all five policy/trajectory records reused after exact protocol/hash verification; no forecast was repeated

step_context.use: preserved auxiliary data; NaN placeholders allowed; not a simulator input

graph.pairs: uncapped undirected pairs with distance <= radius
graph.message_edges: both directions per pair; no self loops
graph.priority: max endpoint score; lexicographic pair-ID tie breaking
graph.training_difference: training graph is capped, self-looped and uses strict distance < radius
graph.normalization: original saved base-radius edge/boundary features and noise-adjusted acceleration decoder

risk.units: per-coordinate normalized acceleration variance, converted with model.head_to_variance
risk.initialization: one explicit base-graph warmup on initial six observed frames; mean discarded; cost included
risk.forecast: exact floor(.25 * available annulus pairs) from first forecast; subsequently cache risk from own selected graph

protocol.autonomy: only first six frames observed; no future truth or prescribed kinematic replacement in controller

random_seed.rule: base + 1000*training_seed + source_index; same stream within paired seeds

guards.nonfinite: state, prediction or raw/converted risk, including warmup
guards.warmup_mean: discarded mean must be finite, but absolute-coordinate guard applies only to accepted state and actual forecasts

metrics.mse: mean squared position error over particles and coordinates; equal trajectories within checkpoint
metrics.failure: full-horizon error undefined if any required trajectory fails or is missing; no survivors-only average
metrics.boundary: exact fraction outside, fraction outside by >1e-6, and excursion magnitude, with same-frame truth reference
metrics.timing: synchronized wall clock; host candidates, selection, tensor transfers, original forward/decoder, metrics and warmup included
metrics.timing_caveat: single measurement in fixed policy order; first policy may include lazy device initialization; compare controlled repeated same-state timings separately
